title: Gate assessment
description: A human-recorded gate outcome (GAT). Deterministic checks and the readiness score inform the assessor; they never produce the outcome. No AI produces a gate outcome. Examples are illustrative examples using synthetic data.

gate_assessment_id.description: Unique ID of the gate assessment.

phase_id.description: Phase instance whose gate was assessed; its lifecycle_phase_key must equal the gate's phase_id.

outcome.description: Gate outcome from standard/lifecycle-terms.yaml. Recorded by a named human.

assessor_person_id.description: The named human who recorded the outcome. Never an agent, rule, or system.

evidence_types_provided.description: Artifact types from lifecycle/lifecycle.yaml that the assessor reviewed.

evidence_refs.description: IDs of records the assessor reviewed, such as tasks, milestones, or a readiness scorecard.

condition_refs.description: IDs of the records that track each condition. Required when the outcome is pass_with_conditions.

reason.description: Why the assessor chose this outcome. Plain operational text; no private notes or personal judgments.

schema_version.description: Version of the R1 core record schemas (0.1.0). Events carry the shared standard version instead.

examples.reason: Design approved. Integration access is not yet confirmed and is tracked as a risk.
